newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: SLOVAK C.BANK SAYS NO REV REPO TENDER ON WEDNESDAY.
newsitem.headline: SLOVAK C.BANK SAYS NO REV REPO TENDER ON WEDNESDAY.

text.p: The National Bank of Slovakia (NBS) said it would not hold a tender for short-term securities repurchase or reverse repurchase on Wednesday.
According to official NBS figures, the banking sector is in a liquidity surplus, with banks' minimum reserve demands fulfilled at 104.87 percent as of Tuesday, after 105.58 percent the previous day.

On Tuesday, the NBS rejected all 400 million crowns worth of bids for its seven-day securities reverse repurchase tender for the second consecutive day, due to "higher-than-previously accepted" rates of the bids and their relatively low volumes.
